name: Mogliano Veneto (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mogliano Veneto (a crescent and star, a cornucopia and waves) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Mogliano Veneto, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 18 January 1988.

features.role: Mogliano Veneto arms — crescent and star, cornucopia and waves, crowned, within branches
